About the Role
We are looking for an experienced and curious AI Software Developer with strong Python programming skills and hands-on experience working with Large Language Models (LLMs).
Our client has established an AI platform that can be configured for various applications, primarily focused on improving software development efficiency. You will contribute to developing intelligent solutions and automation pipelines that support and streamline engineering activities.
This is an exciting opportunity to work at the intersection of traditional software engineering, machine learning and generative AI, collaborating with different development teams to bring innovative ideas into practice.
Key Responsibilities
Design, develop and maintain automation pipelines to support and automate engineering tasks.

Combine conventional software automation techniques with Large Language Models (LLMs).

Develop and implement AI-driven solutions to improve software development efficiency.

Work in an agile environment, focusing on delivering and demonstrating practical results.

Collaborate with different development teams to configure and adapt the machine learning platform to their specific applications.

Support teams in exploring, testing and implementing new AI capabilities.

Identify opportunities for improvement and proactively contribute to technical solutions.

Required Qualifications
Master's degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related field.

Strong software engineering and software design skills.

Excellent programming skills, particularly in Python.

Hands-on experience working with Large Language Models (LLMs).

Good understanding of machine learning concepts and applications.

Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English.

Strong collaboration and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build effective working relationships.

Preferred Qualifications
Familiarity with containerization technologies and cloud platforms.

Experience with Kubernetes.

Familiarity with DevOps practices and tools.

Experience working with automotive software development or system engineering.

Personal Attributes
We are looking for someone who:
Has a curious mindset and enthusiasm for exploring emerging technologies.

Is proactive, responsible and takes ownership of assigned tasks.

Enjoys collaborating with different teams and stakeholders.

Is flexible and comfortable working across different technical application areas.

Takes initiative, experiments with new ideas and focuses on finding practical solutions.

Has a positive, open-minded approach to challenges and is willing to explore possibilities before dismissing them.

What We Offer
An opportunity to work on innovative AI and machine learning applications.

Exposure to practical applications of Generative AI and LLM technologies.

Collaboration with experienced engineering and development teams.

An agile and dynamic working environment.

The opportunity to contribute to solutions that improve modern software engineering processes.

Interested?
If you have a strong background in Python development, experience with LLMs and a passion for building practical AI solutions, we would love to hear from you.
Please submit your CV along with a brief description of your relevant experience.

About us
Hacksaw Studios is a Stockholm-based game studio focused on creating innovative, high-quality gaming experiences. With a focus on performance and precision, we bring ideas to life through technical expertise and creative collaboration. We have wide distribution, and our games are played by millions of people every month by players all over the world.
We are now looking for a Copywriter to join our team in Stockholm. In this role, you will work closely with our game development teams to create clear and engaging content, from in-game texts and game rules to product sheets and documentation. 

The Role
Your key responsibilities include:
Writing clear, engaging in-game texts that explain game rules and features while capturing players’ interest.
Writing and editing product sheets that communicate each game’s features and mechanics.
Creating, maintaining, and updating documentation about our games, platforms, and features.
Coming up with creative names and ideas for our games, characters, and features.
Collaborating with game development teams to understand game mechanics and translate technical information into accessible content.
Using AI tools to support translation and proofreading, reviewing and refining the output for accuracy, clarity, and natural language.
Reviewing and updating content to reflect changes to games and features.
Incorporating feedback and coordinating revisions to meet project deadlines.

What We’re Looking For
Strong written and verbal skills in English
A passion for writing and a creative approach to producing engaging and informative content.
An interest in gaming or iGaming.
The ability to explain game rules, mechanics, and features in clear, accessible language.
Strong attention to detail, with a focus on grammar, consistency, accuracy, and compliance with relevant requirements.
A structured and proactive approach to managing assignments and deadlines.
A collaborative mindset and the ability to gather information from different teams.
Openness to feedback and a willingness to revise and refine your work.

Nice to Have
Experience writing for games or the iGaming industry.
Experience creating game rules, product sheets, or technical documentation.
Familiarity with AI tools such as Visual Studio and Claude for translation, proofreading, and editing.
Experience working closely with creative and technical teams.
Proficiency in Swedish.

What We Offer
A modern office in central Stockholm.
The opportunity to work with experienced and passionate colleagues in the gaming industry.
The chance to help create games played by a global audience.
Real influence, ownership, and opportunities for personal and professional growth.
Wellbeing benefits, including a wellness allowance and regular in-office massages.

Practical Details
This is an on-site position in Stockholm.
Unfortunately, we cannot assist with relocation or visa sponsorship.

Ready to Join the Game Makers?
Apply now! We review applications on a rolling basis.

Roxtec is the world-leading developer and manufacturer of modular-based sealing solutions for cable and pipe penetrations, serving customers in more than 80 markets worldwide.

As Business Area Marketing Manager, you will take on a strategic role within our Global Marketing team, with the opportunity to influence Roxtec’s market presence and contribute to our continued growth. The role combines a global perspective with close collaboration across the business.

Your role
In this role, you will act as a strategic partner to the Business Area organization, turning business strategies and priorities into relevant marketing initiatives. You will identify market opportunities and communication needs and ensure that Roxtec’s value proposition, solutions, and brand are effectively communicated to relevant target audiences. You will report to the Brand & Corporate Communications Manager.

Your responsibilities
• Developing market communication strategies, content, and activities tailored to priority target audiences.
• Creating, implementing, and monitoring global marketing plans aligned with business objectives.
• Managing and coordinating marketing communication projects from concept to execution.
• Collaborating with and supporting local marketing teams around the world.
• Strengthening collaboration between Global Marketing and the Business Area organization.
• Identifying communication priorities and recommending marketing initiatives that create measurable business value.

Your qualifications
• University degree in marketing or a related field.
• Several years of experience in strategic and operational marketing.
• Experience in an international B2B industrial or manufacturing environment is considered an advantage.
• Strong communication and project management skills.
• Experience working closely with business stakeholders to translate business needs into marketing activities.
• Fluency in spoken and written English.

Who you are
You are business-oriented and proactive, with a strong understanding of how marketing and communication can support the business. You enjoy collaborating across functions and cultures and thrive in a dynamic environment.
Speed, simplicity, and flexibility are guiding principles in how we work at Roxtec and should feel natural to you. Read more about our Core Values here (https://www.roxtec.com/en/about-us/about-roxtec/roxtec-core-values/).

What we offer
• A strategic marketing role with an international scope.
• The opportunity to work closely with the business and influence our marketing direction.
• Close collaboration with colleagues across marketing, sales, product management, and business areas worldwide.
• A collaborative environment built on trust and continuous improvement.

Application
If you have any questions regarding the position, please contact Annette Birgerson, Brand & Corporate Communications Manager, Global Marketing, +46 733 31 32 22, or Elin Jurjaks, HR Manager Sweden, +46 733 31 31 89. We review applications and conduct interviews on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to submit your application as soon as possible, no later than 2026-12-06.

Siemens Energy AB i Finspång söker en erfaren VVS-specialist med djup teknisk kompetens inom drift av ventilation, kyla och tryckluft.
Rollen är inriktad på att säkerställa hög tillgänglighet, energieffektivitet, driftsäkerhet och långsiktig funktion i tekniska installationer. 
Du arbetar nära driftorganisation, underhåll, verksamhet och externa leverantörer med felsökning, optimering, förebyggande underhåll och tekniska förbättringar.
Du har även en tekniskt sakkunnig roll i projekt och bidrar med kravställning, granskning och stöd från tidiga utredningar till driftsättning och överlämning.
För att trivas i rollen behöver du vara praktiskt orienterad, analytisk och van att självständigt lösa komplexa driftproblem med säkerheten i fokus.
Huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter
Ansvara för teknisk driftuppföljning av ventilations-, kyl- och tryckluftssystem.
Analysera driftdata, larm, energianvändning och återkommande fel samt föreslå och genomföra förbättringsåtgärder.
Utföra kvalificerad felsökning och rotorsaksanalyser tillsammans med drift- och underhållspersonal.
Optimera systemfunktion, reglerstrategier, temperaturer, luftflöden, trycknivåer och drifttider.
Ta fram och utveckla driftinstruktioner, underhållsplaner, kontrollpunkter och teknisk dokumentation.
Medverka vid statusbedömningar, besiktningar, funktionsprovning, injustering och driftsättning av tekniska system.
Agera tekniskt sakkunnig i projekt genom att ta fram och granska tekniska krav, systemlösningar, handlingar och anbud samt säkerställa att drift-, underhålls- och energikrav beaktas genom hela projektet.
Ställa tekniska krav på entreprenörer och leverantörer samt följa upp att utförda åtgärder ger avsedd funktion.
Vara tekniskt stöd till verksamheten i frågor som rör inneklimat, processkyla, komfortkyla, ventilation och tryckluft.

Erfarenhet
Flerårig erfarenhet av teknisk drift, underhåll och felsökning inom ventilation, kyla och tryckluft, gärna från industriella anläggningar eller annan verksamhet med höga krav på tillgänglighet.
Kompetens
Relevant teknisk utbildning inom VVS, energi, driftteknik eller motsvarande kompetens förvärvad genom arbetslivserfarenhet.
Mycket god kunskap om ventilationssystem, luftbehandling, flödesbalansering, filter, fläktar, värmeåtervinning och styrning.
God kunskap om kylsystem, kylmaskiner, värmepumpar, köldbärarsystem, kondensorer och tillhörande reglerfunktioner.
God kunskap om tryckluftssystem, kompressorer, torkar, filtrering, distributionsnät, läckagesökning och energieffektiv drift.
Erfarenhet av styr- och övervakningssystem samt förmåga att tolka driftbilder, trendkurvor, larm och reglersekvenser.
Förmåga att utföra och bedöma mätningar av temperatur, tryck, flöde, luftkvalitet och energiprestanda.
Erfarenhet av energioptimering, förebyggande underhåll och tekniska förbättringar med ett tydligt livscykelperspektiv.
Det är meriterande med kompetens inom energi, exempelvis energianalys och energieffektivisering av tekniska installationer.
Förmåga att läsa och granska ritningar, flödesscheman, driftkort, funktionsbeskrivningar och tekniska manualer.
Kunskap om relevanta myndighetskrav och säkerhetsregler för VVS-, kyl- och tryckluftsanläggningar.
Personlig profil
Engagerad
Drivande
Djup teknisk kompetens och erfarenhet av drift inom ventilation, kyla och tryckluft
Ansvarstagande och strukturerad
Analytisk och metodisk vid felsökning
Bra initiativförmåga
Lösnings och förbättringsorienterad
Initiativtagande
Självständig

God samarbetsförmåga
Language: English, Swedish
Mejla CV och en kort presentation till info@ndpconsult.se. Vi går igenom ansökningar löpande.

Company description:
Ericsson AB
Job description:   Join our Team   About this opportunity:
 Are you passionate about driving innovation and working on groundbreaking 5G and 6G mobile communication solutions? Do you thrive in a flexible working culture, where new insights are championed, and you are encouraged to develop new skills? Then join Ericsson and our team in Stockholm, Sweden. 
 We are looking for an FPGA Developer within the Ericsson Silicon organization. You will work with dedicated engineers passionate about developing world-class Radio and RAN Compute products. You will contribute to the FPGA team by developing and integrating high-performance FPGA solutions. 
 As part of our global organization, you'll collaborate with talented teams across our different sites. We are committed to Agile principles, fostering a collaborative and innovative work environment that encourages creativity and teamwork. 
  
 What you will do:
  Design and implement FPGA-based Radio and RAN Compute solutions. 
   Develop and optimize FPGA designs for performance, power and cost-efficiency. 
   Apply industry-standard tools and methodologies for FPGA development and implementation. 
   Stay up to date with relevant FPGA technologies, tools and development methods. 
   Document design specifications, test procedures and results. 
   Participate in design reviews and contribute ideas to improve FPGA solutions. 
   Develop testbenches and test cases for your FPGA designs, following functional specifications, agreed verification plans and Ericsson development processes. 
   Use functional and code coverage results to identify verification gaps and meet agreed coverage targets. 
   Debug RTL issues found in simulation and on hardware, together with other designers. 
   Collaborate with hardware, software, systems and integration teams across Radio and RAN Compute development to understand product requirements and contribute to efficient solutions. 
   Contribute to the continuous improvement of products, tools and processes. 
  
 
 The skills you bring:
  A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical or Computer Engineering or equivalent. 
   3–5 years of experience in FPGA/ASIC development, including RTL design and verification. 
   Solid knowledge of FPGA technology, design environment and methodology. 
   Hands-on use of FPGA design tools (e.g., Vivado, Quartus, or similar). 
   Proficiency in a hardware description language (HDL) such as Verilog or VHDL. 
   Working knowledge of interfaces and protocols such as DDR, AXI4, PCIe, SPI or I2C. 
   Scripting skills, for example in Python, Tcl or shell scripting. 
   Ability to create RTL testbenches to verify your own designs. 
   Familiarity with hardware architecture and digital signal processing. 
   Knowledge of SystemVerilog and UVM experience is a plus. 
   An analytical, results-oriented approach with the ability to manage priorities and meet agreed commitments. 
   Good English spoken and written communication skills. 
   Self-motivation and the ability to work independently and collaborate effectively with others. 
   Experience collaborating across teams and sites.

Key Requirements:
Degree in Quantity Surveying or Construction Cost Management. 
B.Sc. Construction Economics / Quantity Surveying with 4-5 years’ experience at Senior QS level
A proven track record in delivering complex projects on time and within budget
Chartered MSCSI / MRICS or embarking on the APC process
Time management and communication skills. 
Computer literacy and digital systems proficiency. Microsoft Office, Cubit / CostX, COINS
Reporting and administrative skills. 
Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English 

As a Senior Quantity Surveyor, you will play a key role in the successful commercial delivery of projects, providing commercial leadership across cost management, contractual administration, and commercial governance. Through effective cost control, value management, procurement strategy, and commercial risk management, you will help drive strong commercial performance throughout the project lifecycle.
Working closely with project teams, clients, subcontractors, and other key stakeholders, you will support commercial decision-making across tendering, contract administration, commercial analysis, and project cost planning. Through collaboration and effective commercial management, you will contribute to positive commercial outcomes and the successful delivery of projects.

Key Responsibilities:
Reporting to the Commercial Director, your key responsibilities may vary depending on the nature and stage of the project being worked on, but can include: 
Tendering & Contract Administration 
Prepare and manage tender documentation, bills of quantities, tender pricing information and contract-related commercial documentation. 
Analyse subcontractor quotations and support commercially sound appointment decisions. 

Cost Planning & Commercial Management 
Manage cost control, value management and commercial performance across assigned projects. 
Support valuations, payment assessments, final accounts and retention management. 

Procurement & Subcontractor Management 
Advise on procurement strategy and support the development and management of project procurement schedules. 
Manage subcontractor packages, including tendering, appointments, payments, claims and final accounts. 

Commercial Risk & Change Management 
Identify and assess commercial risks and support the development of appropriate mitigation measures. 
Identify and manage variations, contractual claims, delays and disruption in accordance with contract requirements. 

Commercial Reporting 
Prepare and support commercial reporting, including cost value reconciliation, cash flow, material and subcontractor cost updates. 

Contract Management 
Support the administration of main contracts and subcontract agreements, ensuring contractual requirements and procedures are appropriately followed. 

Team Support 
Mentor and support junior and project Quantity Surveyors.  

Key Skills: 
Cost management, value management, and commercial risk management skills. 
Procurement strategy and commercial planning skills. 
Contract administration and contractual claims management skills. 
Tendering, estimating, and commercial analysis skills. 
Subcontractor management, valuation, and payment administration skills. 
Commercial reporting and analytical skills. 
Feasibility assessment and commercial advisory skills.

Role Purpose
Drive the optimization of metallurgical processes across the aluminium extrusion value chain. 
Ensure consistent product quality and strengthen operational excellence through expertise in alloys, heat treatment, and process performance. Collaborate with research, operations, commercial teams, customers, institutes, and universities to solve technical challenges and develop advanced aluminium extrusion solutions.
What you will be doing
Provide metallurgical expertise for aluminium extrusion operations, including casting, homogenization, extrusion, quenching, stretching, and aging
Develop, evaluate, and qualify new alloys, process technologies, and extrusion products
Develop and optimize alloy performance for mechanical and functional properties, extrusion productivity, and sustainability
Collaborate with production teams to establish process standards and best practices
Support customer projects with technical expertise and metallurgical guidance
Support root cause analysis and problem-solving for quality issues related to alloy selection, mechanical properties, and geometrical stability
Conduct metallurgical investigations, laboratory testing, and failure analyses
Prepare technical reports, specifications, and customer documentation
Ensure work is performed in compliance with the Hydro Quality system, HSE regulations, policies, and standardized operating procedures
Perform other tasks assigned by the responsible manager that support the operation of the unit and comply with applicable laws and company rules
Comply with area-specific customer requirements

What will make you successful?
PhD or Master’s degree in Physical Metallurgy, Materials Science, or a related technical discipline
Strong knowledge of aluminium alloys
Knowledge of heat treatment, precipitation hardening, recrystallization, grain structure control, and mechanical property development
Familiarity with metallography, microscopy, hardness testing, tensile testing, quality systems, ISO standards, and customer qualification requirements is preferred
Experience in aluminium extrusion, aluminium processing, or a metallurgical manufacturing environment
Practical experience with metallurgical testing and analysis techniques
Experience with automotive, building systems, industrial, electrical, or renewable energy applications is preferred
Knowledge of adjacent fields such as corrosion, extrusion simulation, or process modelling is an advantage
Familiarity with data analytics tools, including Power BI and Python, is an asset
Fluent English and Swedish both written and spoken
Curious, data-driven, and motivated to solve complex technical challenges
Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities
Ability to combine deep metallurgical knowledge with practical manufacturing understanding
Excellent communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills
Able to work effectively with research, operational, commercial, customer, and academic partners
Focused on measurable improvements in product performance, quality, operational efficiency, and customer success

What we offer you
A high-impact role in advanced manufacturing projects
Opportunities to work with cutting-edge technologies
International collaboration and exposure across sites
A dynamic and hands-on technical environment
Autonomy and responsibility in driving process improvements
Travel opportunities and involvement in on-site operations
A strong culture of quality, safety, and continuous learning

Your role
We are looking for a leader who is passionate about developing people, creating structure, and driving continuous improvement in a complex technical environment.
 
As Team Manager Infrastructure Office, you will lead a team of highly skilled specialists organized in two Scrum teams. The team plays a critical role in enabling and supporting one of Atlas Copco's strategic software platforms, providing the infrastructure, tools, and expertise needed to develop the next generation of connected products.
 
This is a leadership role where your success will be measured by your ability to develop people, create structure, drive continuous improvement, and ensure delivery in a business-critical environment.

Your responsibilities will include:
Leading, coaching, and developing the team and its individuals
Driving process development, quality assurance, and operational excellence
Managing recruitment, competence development, and resource planning
Overseeing the infrastructure, tools, and platform capabilities that support software development across R&D
Ensuring efficient operation of server infrastructure used for testing and software compilation
Supporting production testing and helping resolve business-critical customer issues where hardware and software intersect
Securing and developing key competencies within the team, including specialized Wi-Fi expertise
Collaborating with stakeholders across R&D to support current and future platform needs

 
You will be part of the department management team and contribute to the continued development of our software platforms, engineering capabilities, and ways of working. The Infrastructure Office is part of a newly formed department within R&D.

 
Your skills and experience
We believe you are an experienced leader who enjoys building high-performing teams and creating clarity in complex environments.
 
You bring:
Experience leading teams as a manager, project leader, or similar leadership role
A strong ability to drive change, improve processes, and establish efficient ways of working
Experience working in software development organizations
Understanding of embedded software development, Devops and Linux-based environments
Experience working with agile teams and Scrum methodologies
Strong communication, planning, and stakeholder management skills
Excellent English communication skills, both written and spoken

 
As a person, you are structured, collaborative, and able to balance operational priorities with long-term development. You empower others, build trust, and create the conditions for your team to succeed. You are comfortable leading experienced specialists and are able to navigate both strategic discussions and urgent operational challenges.
 
Your job location
 
This position is based in Nacka, Stockholm, Sweden. Extensive collaboration takes place across our global R&D organization, providing opportunities to work with colleagues around the world.
Application process
Our selection process includes interviews, skills assessments and a background check. We look forward to getting to know you, learning about your strengths, and discussing how you can grow with us.

Are you ready to Shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
 Please submit your application no later than 24 December 2026. Selection and interviews are ongoing. For questions regarding the recruitment process, contact Adrian Lyng at Adrian.Lyng@se.ey.com. Mission
Neko is redefining what prevention means, from treating illness when it arrives, to sustaining health before it's ever at risk. Our mission: make data-driven, preventative care accessible to more people, before symptoms appear.
In a single, non-invasive visit under an hour, proprietary technology and direct clinical care combine to deliver personalised, actionable insights. It's a team that thinks in 10x, not 10%. Every role here plays a part in building a world where prevention is the norm, and where your work genuinely helps people live longer, healthier lives.

Be part of the medical technology revolution – Neko Health is expanding and looking for talented assistant nurses to join our team. Are you ready for an exciting career where you can make a real difference? This is your chance to become part of our dynamic team and help shape the exciting journey ahead!
In this role you will be at the center of our mission. You will be a key person in ensuring the smooth operation and high quality of our activities. You will work closely in teams with other skilled medical operators and experienced professionals, but you will also have the opportunity to take initiative and work independently.
We are looking for full-time assistant nurses who are comfortable working a variety of shifts, including daytime, evening, and Saturday shifts. The role requires a minimum commitment of one evening shift per week and one Saturday shift per month.
Minimum Qualifications
Relevant healthcare education as an assistant nurse.
Clinical skills: Confident in performing ECGs and blood sampling. Minimum of one year of clinical experience.
Excellent customer service skills: Warm, friendly, and professional approach. You are solution-oriented, flexible, and committed to delivering high-quality patient care.
Start-up mindset: Comfortable working in a fast-paced, evolving environment. Adaptable to change and digitally proficient with good technical skills.
Strong communication skills: Clear, structured, and pedagogical in your communication.
Language skills: Fluent in Swedish and highly proficient in English.

We offer a dynamic work environment with a high degree of autonomy that fosters growth and development. If you are passionate about building a better healthcare system for everyone and you thrive in a fast-paced environment, we would love to hear from you.
Interviews are ongoing, so don't hesitate to send in your application today!

jobs.occupation: Cyber Security Engineer  Industrial Control Systems
jobs.description:
På ABB hjälper vi industrier att bli mer resurseffektiva och renare – och varje person här bidrar till resultaten. Du kommer att få möjlighet att leda, få stöd att växa och kunna vara stolt över den påverkan vi skapar tillsammans. Gå med oss och hjälp till att driva det som driver världen.
Denna position rapporterar till:
Digital Lead - Regional
__
You’ll join ABB Energy Industries, part of ABB’s Automation division. We deliver electrical automation and digitalization solutions to industries including nuclear power, district heating, hydropower, water, pharmaceuticals and chemicals, using ABB’s industry-leading technologies.
In this role, you’ll help deliver our cybersecurity portfolio and make a meaningful difference for our customers.
Your responsibilities
Design and implement secure OT solutions and interfaces with IT systems. Assess cybersecurity risks, identify security gaps and recommend effective remedies.
Develop robust system and network architectures.
Assess and document the cybersecurity posture of OT systems and network infrastructure.
Implement disaster recovery solutions for OT systems.
Deliver security updates and foundational security controls as part of service agreements.
Provide services such as IT/OT system hardening, role-based access control and risk assessments, helping customers meet cybersecurity standards and requirements, including the NIS2 Directive.

Your background
You have a bachelor’s degree in computer science, information technology or a related field—or equivalent experience. Most importantly, you bring practical experience with cybersecurity solutions and services, as well as OT/IT architecture or infrastructure.

You will coordinate the executive management agenda, prepare strategic analyses and decision-making material for executive management and Board meetings, lead group-wide projects and support potential M&A opportunities.

Drive the development of Nobina’s group strategy and business planning process

Coordinate the executive management agenda in collaboration with the CEO and CFO

Prepare strategic analyses and decision-making material for executive management and Board meetings

Our culture is built on respect, care, and responsibility, and we constantly seek new perspectives to drive innovation.

You get to

Veritaz is a leading IT staffing solutions provider in Sweden, committed to advancing individual careers and aiding employers in ensuring the perfect talent fit. With a proven track record of successful partnerships with top companies, we have rapidly grown our presence in the USA, Europe, and Sweden as a dependable and trusted resource within the IT industry.
Job Overview
Role Summary
Our client is seeking an experienced Design Engineer for a long-term consulting assignment focused on chassis integration for battery-electric heavy-duty vehicle solutions. The role covers the mechanical design and integration of components and systems within the chassis, including sheet metal structures, brackets and installation solutions, pneumatic components and installations, component packaging, and chassis integration. Experience in at least one of these areas is required, while broader experience spanning multiple areas is advantageous.
Key Responsibilities
Design and develop mechanical components, brackets, and installation solutions for heavy-duty vehicle chassis.
Produce and maintain 3D models and 2D engineering drawings using CATIA V5 and applicable design standards.
Manage component packaging, mechanical interfaces, tolerances, and installation requirements within the chassis environment.
Develop solutions involving sheet metal, plastic, and pneumatic components, with consideration for manufacturing feasibility.
Collaborate with suppliers and cross-functional engineering teams throughout the development process.
Participate in design reviews, validation activities, and technical investigations.
Maintain accurate technical and engineering documentation.
Provide technical support to production when required.
Independently plan and drive assigned design activities while contributing to technical knowledge sharing within the team.

Technical Stack & Requirements
CAD: CATIA V5 for both 3D modeling and 2D engineering drawings.
Mechanical design: Strong competence in sheet metal design and/or pneumatic system design.
Engineering analysis: Practical experience with tolerance analysis and the management of mechanical interfaces.
Vehicle integration: Understanding of component packaging, installation constraints, and chassis integration.
Manufacturing: Knowledge of design-for-manufacturability principles, particularly for sheet metal, plastic, and/or pneumatic components.
Development environment: Previous R&D experience involving heavy-duty vehicle development.

Qualifications & Experience
A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a relevant engineering discipline is required, together with at least three years of design engineering experience. Candidates must have previous research and development experience from heavy-duty vehicle development, hands-on CATIA V5 competence, and a strong background in sheet metal and/or pneumatic design. Previous experience with chassis design and installation for heavy-duty vehicles is advantageous, as is experience combining several of the relevant technical disciplines. The role requires the ability to drive design work independently and collaborate effectively with suppliers and cross-functional teams. Fluency in English is required.

jobs.occupation: Take your nursing career to Northern Norway
jobs.description:
Imagine building your nursing career in one of Europe’s most spectacular regions, surrounded by Arctic nature, close-knit communities and a healthcare system where your skills are truly valued.
We are recruiting EU-trained nurses for permanent positions in municipal healthcare services in Finnmark, Northern Norway. You will mainly work within home care services or nursing homes, providing important care and becoming part of an experienced and supportive healthcare team.
Moving to another country is a big step, but you will not have to do it alone. We provide free Norwegian language training, assistance with authorisation, relocation support and personal follow-up throughout the entire process.
Your main responsibilities include:
Providing home nursing care to patients in their own homes
Working in a nursing home or assisted living facility
Daily patient follow-up, medication management, observation and documentation
Close collaboration with relatives, GPs and other healthcare professionals
Contributing to quality improvement and development of local routines

We are looking for someone who:
Has a valid license as a nurse from an EU/EEA country
Is motivated to obtain Norwegian authorisation (we assist with the process)
Speak fluent English and are highly motivated to learn Norwegian
Are willing to complete our free Norwegian language course
Works independently and in a structured way
Enjoys teamwork and has genuine compassion for patients
Is flexible and able to adapt to different work situations
Holds a driver’s license 

We offer:
A full-time permanent position
Competitive salary and working conditions
A warm, inclusive and supportive team
Opportunities for professional development
Free online Norwegian language course with a private teacher
Relocation assistance and help with housing
Personal follow-up throughout the recruitment and relocation process

Why Finnmark?
Finnmark is Norway’s northernmost region and offers a different pace of life than larger cities. Here, you will find close-knit communities and easy access to nature.
Many international healthcare professionals choose Finnmark because of the combination of meaningful work, affordable living and attractive financial benefits. The region also offers unique experiences throughout the year, from the midnight sun in summer to the northern lights during winter.
As a nurse in the municipal healthcare services, you will play an important role in the local community and work closely with patients, relatives and colleagues in a supportive and collaborative environment.
Financial benefits of working in Finnmark:
Lower income tax rate (18.5% compared to 22% in the rest of Norway)
Additional annual tax deduction of up to NOK 45,000
No electricity consumption tax for households
Free kindergarten (meal costs may apply)
Additional child benefit for families with children

Apply today or get in touch with us for more information.

We believe in a world where everyone is empowered to shape the life they dream of, regardless of their background or location.

This is a part-time position located in Stockholm. As a Sales Cashier/Store Employee, you will be a central part of our team and the face of our business. You will be responsible for delivering an outstanding customer experience while contributing to our sales goals.

Carry out transactions for money transfers and currency exchange with high precision and efficiency.
Actively engage customers to understand their needs and offer appropriate financial services.
Provide personalized and professional service by answering questions and providing clear guidance.
Manage cash flow carefully and ensure accurate accounting according to company guidelines.
Help achieve and exceed sales goals by building trust and customer loyalty.
Be flexible with working hours and be able to work evenings, weekends and holidays when needed.

 
We are looking for you who
Has experience in sales and customer service (meritorious).
Fluent in Swedish and English, with proficiency in a third language such as Georgian, Turkish, Russian or Ukrainian.
Is self-motivated, goal-oriented and thrives in a dynamic work environment.
Have a strong customer focus and the ability to create a positive experience for our customers.
Has experience in cashier work and handling of cash (meritorious).
Is flexible and can adapt to different tasks and shifts. Weekend work occurs.
Have basic computer skills (Word, Excel).

 
PERKS & BENEFITS
An exciting and dynamic work environment in an international company.
Opportunity to develop in sales and financial services.
An inclusive and multicultural team where we value diversity.

We look forward to hearing from you and welcoming you to our team at Ria Financial Services!

Thus, we can provide guidance, training, and seminars about the latest regulations. The assignment is at one of our clients who would like you to start asap with a minimum duration of one year.

Participate in quality risk management procedures for GDP

Academic degree within life science/engineering or pharmacy

Technical/functional area skills
Beneficial with knowledge of applicable international standards and guidelines for Pharmaceuticals within GDP in EU and in national legislation as applicable.
Beneficial with experience of complaint, and deviation and change management
